body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Filing gate: **④ a coordination child.** This is a sub-issue of #27377, the v18.3.0 release test sweep anchor. RUNNER's extraction obligation closes checklist-accuracy findings on the anchor. Slices S1–S8 (#28349, #28351, #28352, #28338–#28342) and the held items (#28345 → #28551) have all landed. These 20 lines are what W3-C1R parked after them (anchor comment 6554042054, record #28545 at `eeec88d1`). The anchor cannot close until they are in the ledger (#27377 §2).
Business reason: the P0 smoke is the release's standing evidence. Each stale step below costs every future P0 run a hand-walk or a false finding (counts, codes and routes that moved since `c4c515ad`).
Reader: any `domain:devx` seat, one PR, following #27164's shape: `revision` +1, history kept as a prefix, one row citing #28545, and `Part of #27377`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "wave-3 checklist accuracy slice" → S1–S8, all closed; none covers W3-C1R's lines.
⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ No product code.

## Scope

**Files:** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/` — access-security (4), api-backend (2), ai (1), cli (2), platform-core (3), approvals (2), records-forms (1), studio-authoring (2), integration-system (3). No other file.

Re-verify each row against the current head before editing. A row that no longer holds is reported as fixed upstream. A clause is only made stronger or more precise, never weaker.

| # | item | clause | finding (W3-C1R, verbatim) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` | steps[0] / steps[6] | stale: describes the set grant only as a system-context insert. Should say a live run uses admin POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set {user_id, permission_set} (201, effective) and POST /api/v1/data/sys_business_unit_member for the delegate |
| 2 | `access-security.owd-sharing-matrix` | steps[3] | stale: the project body names status 'planned' but not the required account lookup (project.object.ts required: true); without it the create answers 400 "Account is required". Should spell {name, status:'planned', account: a seeded account id} |
| 3 | `access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only` | acceptance[0].verify | stale: prescribes --maxWorkers=2 against RUNNER's memory fact. Should say --maxWorkers=1, one package at a time |
| 4 | `access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only` | steps[0]/[1] / acceptance[1] | missing: the title names _migrate-stored and POST /automation but no step drives them. Live they answer 403 FORBIDDEN and 403 PERMISSION_DENIED (dispatcher-wrapper). Should add both doors and name their codes |
| 5 | `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` | acceptance[6] (clause, verify) | stale since #27842: expects ACTION_DISABLED "naming showcase_bulk_reassign"; the body is {code, message, httpStatus} with the generic turned-off sentence naming no action (the live pin ignores the name too). Should say 409 ACTION_DISABLED with the turned-off sentence on the /actions/showcase_task/showcase_bulk_reassign route, target flow untouched |
| 6 | `api-backend.query-contract-matrix` | — | missing clause: the #26644 contract (empty projection / unrecognised $count → 400) has no acceptance or negative row, so its recheck rests on a dispatcher note. Should add a negative |
| 7 | `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` | steps[7] | stale (stricter since #27692): revoking "as the admin" with the admin API key answers 403 "Changing an API key requires a signed-in session". Should say to revoke from the admin's signed-in session or the API Keys page |
| 8 | `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` | acceptance[1] | wording: the literal plan-file-required appears only as the --json reason; the text run prints "✗ Refused: --apply executes only a plan you reviewed…". Should say which output carries it |
| 9 | `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` | acceptance[5] / cli-18-prerelease-db recipe | time-dependent: as the dump ages, boot 2 resumes its two paused showcase_task_follow_up wait runs, which fail at notify (no assignee) and are replaced by run_run_ history rows; the 9→9 count holds but two pre-existing ids vanish. The recipe should say so |
| 10 | `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` | negative[3] | stale since #27507: says the member's settings route renders inside the opening app shell; it now waits on Setup's access verdict and shows "You don't have access to this app" with no shell. Should say that, keeping 403 SETTINGS_FORBIDDEN on the wire as the scored part |
| 11 | `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` | steps[5] / steps[4] | stale counts: this run read Setup 50 destinations and Account 8 (steps[5] says 48), and 11 settings namespaces (steps[4] lists 9; add sms and lifecycle) |
| 12 | `platform-core.nav-surfaces-render` | steps[0]/[2] | stale since #27525: the served showcase nav has 50 leaves including nav_report_index while SURFACES holds 49, so /reports is a hand-walk every run. Should add a Reports entry to SURFACES or name it as the standing hand-walk; boot-health's id diff now reads 51 including the separator |
| 13 | `approvals.account-app-entry` | steps[3] | missing: the account app is reached from the avatar menu's Profile item (/apps/com.objectstack.account/component/account/profile_card), not the app switcher, which offers only Showcase / Back to home / All apps. Should say so |
| 14 | `approvals.account-app-entry` | acceptance[0] | wording: asks the runner to run pnpm console:build itself. Should accept the dispatcher's build ready line plus the served-entry hash check |
| 15 | `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` | acceptance[4] / steps[5] | missing: at 1440 px the record page also has a top-level Activity tab (?related=timeline). Should name that door beside the panel header; the right-column panel can lag the update line until a fresh read |
| 16 | `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` | steps[3] | stale since #27830: the publish toast now reads "Published 1 item in this package" with "Members can use it once a permission set grants them access." and an Open Access action; "(one atomic release)" is gone |
| 17 | `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` | steps[2] | minor: Add field is on the Form tab (the object surface opens on Records after a navigation), and an option's stored value derives from its label ("In Repair" gives in_repair), so it must be overwritten to get wip |
| 18 | `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` | acceptance[6].verify | minor: the 405 now lists Allowed: DELETE, GET, HEAD, PATCH; the item's "GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE" mixes in the collection's POST |
| 19 | `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` | source / knownGaps | missing: two credential routes new since c4c515ad are unnamed — the code-author env route OS_DATASOURCE_NAME_PASSWORD behind OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS (now appended to every refusal; CODE_DEFINED_CREDENTIAL_ROUTE, datasource-env-credential.ts) and the external.connector channel (ADR-0015 D7) with its three refusals |
| 20 | `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` | steps[0] | observation: at runtime driver 'mongo' with an inline password reports only config.password, while the build door names the driver refusal too. Should say which door names both |

## Done when

All 20 rows are edited or reported as fixed upstream. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green. The PR lands, and #27377 §2's "not yet in the ledger" line is retired.
